positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Led frontend development of core features for Compass One (a next-generation client dashboard) and Business Tracker (an end-to-end transaction management platform for real estate agents), delivering document storage management, eSign functionality between agents and clients, and polished, secure, performant UI experiences — working closely with Product, Design, and Agent Experience teams throughout
• Drove frontend platform health across the organization — contributing to shared design system components, improving e2e test stability and coverage, and leading on-call rotations while establishing improved incident response and best practices across engineering teams

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Lead UI/UX engineer on Carta Liquidity, the platform developed by Carta to provide liquidity events (e.g. tender offers, block trades) and financial products to private companies. Relaunched rebranded product website for Liquidity (utilizing SSG/Gatsby) and bridged the gap between Product Design and Engineering teams, providing UI/UX/design review and adding product features, responsible for in-product external and internal user flows working within React monorepos
• UI/UX Developer and Designer on Carta’s Design System, Ink. Improving usability and performance while adding new features to Carta’s shared components and design system guidelinesUI/UX Developer and Designer on Carta’s Design System, Ink. Improving usability and performance while adding new features to Carta’s shared components and design system guidelines

positions.title: Web Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, maintained and applied performance improvements across all asana.com pages (1000+) including marketing, product, pricing and support pages as well as documentation in the Asana Guide
• Completed extensive site-wide replatforming from legacy codebase (Static v1 + VanillaJS/jQuery) to modern web technologies (Next.js + React) resulting in improved web performance (faster load times, smaller bundle sizes) and improved developer and content producer experience
• Led growth web engineering and A/B testing development across asana.com. Introduced an experimentation framework enabling growth team to increase velocity of experiments run across the site (100+/year) including complex split-testing eCommerce initiatives

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead engineer on initiative to prototype and test variations of the Capital One homepage. Launched a speed/performance-optimized mobile web homepage with 30% smaller payload
• Responsible for maintaining the A/B testing platform on the homepage, developing variations of existing components and using testing tools (Adobe Target, Tableau) to drive growth (winning tests in 2017 totaled approx. $10 million in additional revenue)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led front-end redesign for launch of student loan refinancing (SLR) product landing pages and consumer facing client dashboard. SLR launch raised loans disbursed per month from $1m to $40m in 2015
• Built first version of the referral product/dashboard using React/Redux, leading to increase in high quality organic user growth
